label: prop:substrate-consistency-window
title: Overdetermination of the substrate parameter
html:
The QOU framework relies on a single free parameter: the substrate parameter q. Every observable quantity—masses, couplings, decay rates, and causal structure—is a function of q alone. Independent classes of measurements each restrict q to a narrow range. These ranges overlap, rendering q overdetermined.

Consistency window.

  q  \in  [1.109, 1.112].

See Table 1.

Three independent sectors of physics—strong (mass ratios), electromagnetic (fine structure constant), and weak (beta decay)—all point to the same q. The entire Standard Model parameter space collapses to a single point in the consistency window.
